description: Submits a project made with Agentrica for the projects page of the site, if the user asks (also without a GitHub account). In two steps: 1) with the fields it returns the preview and a code; 2) show the preview to the user and only after they say yes call the tool again with that code. consent and license are true only if the user accepted them in their own words: consent to publishing the form data and permission to show name and description.

agents.description: Ids of the agents used, separated by commas, optional, at most 10.

author.description: Display name, optional, at most 40 characters.

code.description: The preview code, only after the user says yes (second step).

consent.description: The user's consent to publishing the submission data.

departments.description: Codes of the departments used, separated by commas, e.g. AISA, AIWDA.

description.description: What it does and how it used the agents, at most 280 characters, no links.

license.description: The user's permission to show name and description.

url.description: Public https:// link to the project.

name: submit_project
title: Submit a project for the Agentrica site
